verdict.rationale: Memory management is a fair question for a personal AI assistant like Khoj, but the evidence pack never mentions an assistant memory store, nor any way to inspect, edit, or delete remembered facts. Self-hosting so data stays on-device (khoj-docs-38, khoj-docs-3) and indexing of the user's own markdown and org files cover where data lives and what source files it reads. Neither shows that the assistant's memory is user-visible, editable, or kept in an open format.
